title: View of Brooklyn, L.I. from U.S. Hotel, New York
artist: Edwin Whitefield (drawn from nature and on stone); printed in colours by Francis Michelin

title: The Great East River Suspension Bridge, connecting the cities of New York and Brooklyn: View from Brooklyn, looking west
